description:
Intermediate Representation definitions for both transport and application
        layers, plus the SPI surfaces that extensions implement against the IR,
        the pure-function mapper between the two IRs (ir.mapper, relocated
        from the removed franca-mapper module), and the pipeline
        itself (ir.pipeline / ir.route, relocated from the dissolved
        franca-core module — the narrow waist has exactly one home
        now, and everything the pipeline operates on already lived here).
        Key types: TransportFrame, TransportEvent, ApplicationFrame,
        ApplicationEvent, InputItem, ContentBlock, ApplicationTransportMapper,
        FrancaPipeline, TransportSink, PassExecutor, RouteRegistry,
        RoutingExecutor, HookRegistry.

        This is the single dependency an extension (a dialect adapter or a backend
        driver) needs: it carries the IR data records and the two SPI surfaces
        relocated out of the removed adapter-api / driver-api modules:
        - ir.adapter.ApplicationAdapter, ProtocolRequestException — dialect SPI
        - ir.driver.Driver, DriverInstance, HealthCheck, HealthStatus,
          DriverAddresses, DriverErrors — backend driver SPI

        Dependency direction: nothing below this module — the IR depends on no
        other franca module, and every module above it (hosted,
        adapters, drivers, tools, Spring) depends on this one. The pipeline
        reaches the hosted-tool execution layer only through the
        ir.pipeline.PassExecutor seam, which that layer implements.

        Both SPI surfaces and the pipeline declare Flux/Mono return types, so
        this module carries a compile-scope reactor-core dependency. The IR
        data records themselves stay reactor-free; reactor-core is pulled in
        only for the SPI method signatures and the pipeline.
